body:
Someone follows the fantasy to its plain content, and it actually works.

They ask the repeating daydream what it wants, and the answer turns out ordinary and speakable: rest, a different job, being chosen first.

With Neptune sextile Lilith, people who can read imagery get access to the appetite hiding inside it.

The translation is available, but somebody has to sit down and do it.

The result may be unglamorous, but a person who has the want in plain language can request it, and requests can be granted.
